state.description: Only Pokémon currently in this state may be chosen, judged when the choice is made: 「身上放置有伤害指示物的1只【无】宝可梦」 is damaged plus a selector.

oneOf.description: 「…将备战宝可梦放于弃牌区，直到其数量变为3只为止」「选择对手3只备战宝可梦。然后，将未选择的…」: the chooser keeps count matching Pokémon and the others leave.

to.description: discard: 「将…宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，放于弃牌区」 (II.C-01): every card to its owner's discard pile, not a Knock Out. lost: 「…放于放逐区」 (zones.lost-zone), its Pokémon cards, and with attachments return every card. deckTop/deckBottom (own Pokémon only): 「将这只宝可梦放回牌库上方／下方」「…以任意顺序重新排列，放回自己的牌库下方」: on that end of the deck, several cards in the order their owner chooses, the first chosen uppermost (effects.field-return-deck). shuffleBottom: 「…反面朝上重洗，放回（对手的）牌库下方」: shuffled face down, then under the deck (II.E-35).

promotion.description: Explicit reviewed scheduling, not a claim that KO promotion order also applies to non-KO departure. Absent exactly when only Benched Pokémon can leave (target bench): the Active is never vacated. afterRelatedResolution is the ruled schedule (effects.field-return-promotion); sourceOfTruth is this card's own evidence (a card-library record only on a machine definition).

returnAttached.description: effects.attached-return 「将放于双方战斗宝可梦身上的所有卡牌，各放回牌库并重洗牌库」: every card attached to each printed side's Active Pokémon (Energy, Tools; not the evolution cards beneath it) goes to its owner's deck, and each deck that received cards is shuffled; the Pokémon stays in play.
